content: Caddy advisory GHSA-7r4p-vjf4-gxv4 (CVE-2026-30851): forward_auth copy_headers does NOT delete the client-supplied header of the same name. Since PR #6608 (Nov 2024) a MatchNot guard skips the Set op when the auth service omits the header, so the client's own X-Auth-User survives to the backend. Affects v2.10.0-v2.11.1, fixed in v2.11.2. Workaround: unconditional 'request_header -X-Foo' for every copied header BEFORE forward_auth. Companion advisory GHSA-f59h-q822-g45g (CVE-2026-52845): FastCGI normalises '-' to '_', so an underscore alias survives the delete and lands in the same CGI variable.
